US11806490B2.L1_taught: claims 1, 7, 8, 9 — P_CSF → controller → valve (ICP-only, no venous)
US11806490B2.L3d_TEACHES_AWAY: claim 8 — 'attenuate an effect of sudden changes in the signal representing the intracranial pressure' — OPPOSITE of derivative action. Prior art teaches AWAY from L3d.
US11806490B2.L2_L3b_L3e_h_L4_L5_NOT_TAUGHT: No venous pressure, no differential, no posture, no Valsalva, no respiratory, no sleep apnea, no venous congestion, no predictive control

US11389630B2.device_type: Shuntless intracranial PULSE PRESSURE modulator — PASSIVE ball check valves, zero net flow
US11389630B2.ALL_limitations_NOT_TAUGHT: No active control, no sensor, no controller, no venous pressure, no differential. Operates on systolic/diastolic pulse pressure with passive mechanical valves.
US11389630B2.relevance: NOT relevant to L3d frontier — this is a passive device, not a feedback controller

US12653703B2.device_type: Divisional of US 7,691,077 — microneedle + microvalve stent in superior sagittal sinus
US12653703B2.L2_taught: claim 5 — 'pressure differential between the subarachnoid space at said distal ends of said microneedles and the superior sagittal sinus' — PASSIVE proportional differential
US12653703B2.ALL_other_limitations_NOT_TAUGHT: No active control, no sensor, no controller, no derivative, no prediction
US12653703B2.relevance: Confirms L2 is taught (passive proportional differential). NOT relevant to L3d frontier.

3. PREDICTIVE CONTROLLER CEILING: C4 (predictive trajectory) does NOT materially outperform C3 (instantaneous ΔP) in simulation. C4 dominates C3 in only 1/9 states. The predictive-control frontier (L5) is WEAK.
4. DERIVATIVE MECHANISM REMAINS STRONGER: L3d (derivative-on-differential) from V3 remains the stronger candidate. V3.1 showed 53.8% M2 reduction. V7 claim audit confirms no prior art teaches it.
5. HONEST PUSH-THE-ENVELOPE: We attacked the predictive hypothesis and it did NOT survive. The derivative hypothesis (L3d) remains the load-bearing novel mechanism.
